title: Sodium butyrate attenuates experimental neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis by suppressing TLR4-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome-dependent pyroptosis.
authors: Gao, Yanan; Yang, Liting; Wu, Hongya; Yao, Qianqian; Wang, Jiaqi; Zheng, Nan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丁酸钠通过TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3通路抑制坏死性小肠结肠炎，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a fatal intestinal disease in premature infants, and is characterized by intestinal inflammation and disruption of the intestinal barrier. The protective effects of sodium butyrate (NaB) against NEC have been documented, however, the underlying fundamental processes remain unknown. To address this deficit, we used the NEC neonatal rat model to confirm the intestinal protective effect of NaB. We then used network pharmacology and confirmed a role for NaB in the attenuation of NEC and this was associated with the NLRP3 inflammasome and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. These results were verified by proteome analysis in vivo, and molecular docking analysis was used to explore the potential underlying mechanisms, revealing a suppressive function of NaB on NEC, which may be caused by its interaction with the TLR4-mediated NF-kappaB signaling pathway. An in vitro cell model (LPS-stimulated IEC-6 cells) was then established to confirm the docking results. Results using assays involving the NLRP3 (MCC950) and TLR4 (TAK-242) inhibitors suggested that NaB protected intestinal cells from inflammatory injuries during NEC by suppressing the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/NLRP3/cleaved caspase-1/GSDMD inflammasome pathway. These findings indicated that NaB can be used as a potential modulatory and therapeutic candidate for the treatment of NEC.
abstract_zh: 坏死性小肠结肠炎（NEC）是早产儿的一种致命性肠道疾病，其特征为肠道炎症和肠道屏障破坏。丁酸钠（NaB）对NEC的保护作用已有文献记载，然而其潜在的基本机制仍不清楚。为弥补这一不足，我们使用NEC新生大鼠模型确认了NaB的肠道保护作用。随后，我们采用网络药理学方法，确认了NaB在缓解NEC中的作用，并发现这与NLRP3炎症小体和NF-kappaB信号通路相关。这些结果通过体内蛋白质组学分析得到验证，并利用分子对接分析探索潜在机制，揭示NaB对NEC的抑制作用可能源于其与TLR4介导的NF-kappaB信号通路的相互作用。随后建立了体外细胞模型（LPS刺激的IEC-6细胞）以验证对接结果。使用NLRP3（MCC950）和TLR4（TAK-242）抑制剂的检测结果表明，NaB通过抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/NLRP3/cleaved caspase-1/GSDMD炎症小体通路，保护肠道细胞免受NEC期间的炎症损伤。这些发现表明，NaB可作为治疗NEC的潜在调节和治疗候选药物。
